FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Gifts & Keepsakes Boutique, we specialize in a diverse range of unique and thoughtfully curated gift items, including handcrafted souvenirs, artisanal products, and specialty gift wraps. Our operations focus on providing exceptional customer service and creating an inviting shopping atmosphere where customers can find the perfect item for any occasion. We maintain a well-documented inventory management system to ensure all products are accurately accounted for and organized, preventing loss and facilitating customer access. Our shop is located in a vibrant, high-traffic area, frequented by both locals and tourists, which enhances our visibility and customer flow. To safeguard our merchandise and ensure customer safety, we utilize modern security measures including surveillance cameras and a comprehensive training program for our employees on loss prevention and customer service protocols. We are fully compliant with local business regulations, and we regularly conduct inventory assessments to optimize our product offerings and manage stock effectively.
